page.overview:
Who is Cosmic Robin?

The Cosmic Robin is the gender-swapped version of Cosmic Owl.

She has a single appearance in Adventure Time: How to Warrior by Fionna and Cake: A Tale of Deadly Quests, Daring Rescues, and Defeating Evil!

She presumably has a similar purpose to Cosmic Owl, giving croak dreams to the people of Fionna-world and telling them how they may die. It is unknown if she has a sister similar to the Karmic Worm.
